name: Asian-Style Pork Soup with Napa Cabbage, Potatoes, Carrots & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium yellow potatoes
3 medium carrots
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice potatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add veggies to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 4-5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch wide strips.

When the veggies are done, add cabbage, broth, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2839 ml chicken or vegetable broth
⅓ cup soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
